scientific_claim: Across the exact three within-lineage real-byte demand files, the frozen first-half error-guided selector retained at least 80% of full sixteen-motif second-half benefit with exactly seven active and nine retained motifs, remained no worse than the seven-motif static control, and preserved positive covered-position accuracy gain with exact state integrity and no future-half access, mutation, tokenizer use, or capacity growth.
boundary_interpretation: Under the frozen 70% benefit-retention criterion, six active motifs are below threshold (0.60 minimum) while seven active motifs are above threshold (0.80 minimum). The tested useful active-capacity floor for this lineage is therefore seven motifs.
next_question: Test whether the seven-active state can sustain repeated demand shifts and revisit prior demand files without retraining, state mutation, or benefit collapse.
scope: within-lineage real-byte active-capacity boundary on three reused demand files
